points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 伦勃朗1606年7月15日出生于荷兰莱顿的一个富裕磨坊主家庭。1620年起，他在莱顿大学短暂学习古典文学，但很快转向绘画。1621年至1624年间，他师从当地画家雅各布·范·斯瓦宁堡(Jacob van Swanenburgh)，学习历史绘画和明暗对比法。这段时期奠定了他的绘画基础，并培养了他对光影效果的独特敏感度，这成为他日后艺术风格的标志性特征。
points.descriptionEn: Rembrandt was born on July 15, 1606, in Leiden, Netherlands, to a prosperous miller's family. He briefly studied classical literature at Leiden University from 1620 but soon turned to painting. From 1621 to 1624, he apprenticed with local painter Jacob van Swanenburgh, studying historical painting and chiaroscuro techniques. This period established his artistic foundation and developed his unique sensitivity to light and shadow, which became a hallmark of his later style.

points.title: 艺术学徒
points.description: 1625年，伦勃朗前往阿姆斯特丹，在著名画家彼得·拉斯特曼(Pieter Lastman)工作室学习。拉斯特曼对伦勃朗产生了深远影响，特别是他对历史题材的处理方式和戏剧性构图。1631年，伦勃朗回到莱顿，但很快又迁回阿姆斯特丹，开始独立创作。这一时期他创作了《杜普教授的解剖学课》(1632)等早期杰作，确立了他在荷兰艺术界的地位，并开始接受肖像画 commissions，这为他带来了经济上的成功。
points.descriptionEn: In 1625, Rembrandt traveled to Amsterdam to study in the studio of renowned painter Pieter Lastman, who profoundly influenced him, particularly in handling historical subjects and dramatic compositions. In 1631, he returned to Leiden but soon moved back to Amsterdam, beginning his independent career. During this period, he created early masterpieces like 'The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp' (1632), establishing his reputation in the Dutch art world and beginning to receive portrait commissions that brought him financial success.

points.title: 黄金时代
points.description: 1631年至1642年是伦勃朗艺术生涯的黄金时期。1634年，他与萨斯基亚·范·乌伦堡(Saskia van Uylenburgh)结婚，她的财富和社交圈为伦勃朗提供了优越的生活条件。这一时期，他创作了大量肖像画、自画像和历史题材作品，风格日益成熟。1637年，他购买了位于阿姆斯特丹犹太区的豪宅，并建立了自己的工作室。1642年，他完成了代表作《夜巡》(The Night Watch)，这幅作品不仅展示了他的绘画技巧，也体现了他对人物动态和光影效果的独特处理，成为荷兰黄金时代绘画的巅峰之作。
points.descriptionEn: The period from 1631 to 1642 marked Rembrandt's golden age. In 1634, he married Saskia van Uylenburgh, whose wealth and social circle provided him with comfortable living conditions. During this time, he produced numerous portraits, self-portraits, and historical works, with his style increasingly maturing. In 1637, he purchased a grand house in Amsterdam's Jewish quarter and established his own workshop. In 1642, he completed his masterpiece 'The Night Watch,' which not only demonstrated his technical skill but also showcased his unique approach to figures in motion and light effects, becoming the pinnacle of Dutch Golden Age painting.

points.title: 人生转折
points.description: 1642年萨斯基亚去世后，伦勃朗的生活开始走下坡路。1656年，他因投资失败和奢侈生活而破产，被迫变卖财产和艺术品。这一时期，他的艺术风格变得更加内省和深刻，创作了许多宗教题材作品和自画像，如《浪子回头》(The Return of the Prodigal Son, 1669)。尽管面临经济困境，伦勃朗的艺术创作却达到了新的高度，他的作品更加注重情感表达和内在精神，而非外在形式。这一时期，他培养了包括费尔迪南德·波尔(Ferdinand Bol)和戈弗里德·沙克(Gerrit Dou)在内的众多学生，延续了艺术传承。
points.descriptionEn: After Saskia's death in 1642, Rembrandt's life began to decline. In 1656, he went bankrupt due to failed investments and extravagant living, forcing him to sell his property and artworks. During this period, his artistic style became more introspective and profound, creating many religious works and self-portraits like 'The Return of the Prodigal Son' (1669). Despite financial difficulties, his artistic achievements reached new heights, with works focusing more on emotional expression and inner spirit than external form. During this time, he trained numerous students including Ferdinand Bol and Gerrit Dou, continuing his artistic legacy.

points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 1658年至1669年是伦勃朗的晚年时期。他搬到了阿姆斯特丹郊外较为简朴的住所，继续创作。这一时期，他的艺术风格更加自由和实验性，作品如《犹太新娘》(The Jewish Bride, 1665-1669)展现了更加奔放的笔触和丰富的色彩。伦勃朗晚年专注于表达人类情感的深度，他的作品超越了单纯的技巧展示，达到了精神层面的高度。1669年10月4日，伦勃朗在阿姆斯特丹逝世，被安葬在韦斯特教堂(West Church)。尽管生前经历了经济困难和艺术争议，他的作品却在后世获得了极高的评价，对后世艺术发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: The period from 1658 to 1669 marked Rembrandt's late years. He moved to a more modest residence in Amsterdam's outskirts and continued creating. During this time, his artistic style became freer and more experimental, with works like 'The Jewish Bride' (1665-1669) showing more expressive brushwork and richer colors. In his later years, Rembrandt focused on expressing the depth of human emotion, with his works transcending mere technical display to achieve spiritual heights. On October 4, 1669, Rembrandt died in Amsterdam and was buried in the West Church. Despite facing financial difficulties and artistic controversies during his lifetime, his works received high acclaim in later generations and profoundly influenced the development of art.

supporter.zh: 伦勃朗被艺术史学家誉为光影大师，他的明暗对比法(chiaroscuro)和绘画技巧达到了前所未有的高度。他通过细腻的光影处理赋予画面戏剧性和情感深度，使静态的人物形象充满生命力。伦勃朗创作了超过600幅画作和300版画，题材涵盖肖像、自画像、历史和宗教场景，展现了人类情感的丰富性。他的自画像系列尤其珍贵，记录了从青年到老年的艺术演变过程，是艺术史上最全面的自画像创作之一。
supporter.en: Rembrandt is hailed by art historians as a master of light and shadow, whose chiaroscuro techniques and painting skills reached unprecedented heights. Through delicate handling of light and shadow, he imbued his works with dramatic tension and emotional depth, bringing static figures to life. He created over 600 paintings and 300 etchings covering portraits, self-portraits, historical and religious scenes, showcasing the richness of human emotion. His self-portrait series is particularly valuable, documenting his artistic evolution from youth to old age, making it one of the most comprehensive self-portrait collections in art history.

critic.zh: 批评者指出伦勃朗在商业上不够务实，他拒绝迎合当时流行的肖像画风格，坚持自己的艺术理念，导致经济困境。他的《夜巡》因打破传统群体肖像的静态构图而引发争议，甚至遭到委托人的不满。伦勃朗的个人生活也备受争议，包括与亨德里克耶·斯托菲尔斯(Hendrickje Stoffels)的同居关系在当时被视为不道德。此外，他的晚年作品被认为过于粗糙，缺乏早期作品的精致和完美，反映了艺术生涯的衰退。
critic.en: Critics point out that Rembrandt was not pragmatic in business, refusing to cater to popular portrait styles and insisting on his artistic vision, leading to financial difficulties. His 'The Night Watch' caused controversy for breaking the traditional static composition of group portraits, even dissatisfying the clients. His personal life was also controversial, including his relationship with Hendrickje Stoffels, which was considered immoral at the time. Additionally, his late works were seen as too rough, lacking the refinement and perfection of his earlier pieces, reflecting a decline in his artistic career.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，伦勃朗被定义为荷兰黄金时代最伟大的艺术家之一，他的作品代表了巴洛克艺术的巅峰。他的艺术风格影响了从鲁本斯到伦勃朗后世的无数画家，包括印象派和表现主义艺术家。伦勃朗的艺术遗产不仅体现在他的作品本身，还在于他对艺术本质的探索——他超越了单纯的技巧展示，深入探索人类情感和精神世界。在流行文化中，伦勃朗的名字已成为艺术天才的代名词，他的生平故事被多次改编成电影和文学作品，成为艺术史上最具传奇色彩的人物之一。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Rembrandt is defined as one of the greatest artists of the Dutch Golden Age, with his works representing the pinnacle of Baroque art. His style influenced countless painters from Rubens to later artists, including Impressionists and Expressionists. Rembrandt's artistic legacy lies not only in his works but in his exploration of art's essence—he transcended mere technical display to delve deeply into human emotion and the spiritual world. In popular culture, Rembrandt's name has become synonymous with artistic genius, and his life story has been adapted into films and literature multiple times, making him one of the most legendary figures in art history.

self.zh: 绘画的真正目的不是复制可见的东西，而是使不可见的东西变得可见。
self.en: The true aim of painting is not to reproduce the visible, but to make visible.

others.zh: 伦勃朗是所有时代中最伟大的画家，因为他懂得如何将灵魂注入到他的作品中。
others.en: Rembrandt is the greatest of all painters, because he knew how to infuse his works with soul.
